svg.title: Relativistic and classical kinetic energy
svg.desc: Kinetic energy versus speed v from 0 to c. The relativistic kinetic energy (γ − 1)mc² agrees with the classical ½mv² at low speed, but rises far more steeply and grows without limit as v approaches c, shown by a dashed vertical line; the classical curve stays finite. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Relativistic kinetic energy grows rapidly near c
K = (γ − 1)mc², compared with ½mv²; the rest energy mc² is excluded from K. The cursor stops at
